items.title: Directional spectral measure of a Hermitian matrix
Operator-norm bound for bounded complex iid matrices
items.statement: On a common probability space, for each positive integer $n$, let $N_n$ be a positive integer with $n/N_n\to c\in(0,\infty)$, and let $X_n\in\mathbb C^{n\times N_n}$ have independent identically distributed entries $\xi$ satisfying $\mathbb E\xi=0$ and $|\xi|\le K$ almost surely for a fixed $K<\infty$. Then there is a finite constant $C=C(K,c)$ such that, almost surely, $\|X_n\|_{\mathrm{op}}\le C\sqrt{N_n}$ for all sufficiently large $n$.

items.title: Fourth-moment bound for a centered complex quadratic form
Uniqueness of the deformed Marchenko–Pastur fixed point
Hermitian rank-one resolvent update and trace-norm bound
Adapted concentration of bounded complex resolvent quadratic forms
items.statement:
On a common probability space, for each positive integer $n$, let $X_n\in\mathbb C^{n\times N_n}$ have entries from one common iid law with mean zero, unit second absolute moment, and absolute value at most $K$, where $K$ is independent of $n$. Let $T_n\in\mathbb C^{n\times n}$ be deterministic Hermitian positive semidefinite with $\|T_n\|_{\mathrm{op}}\le M$, and let $x_n\in\mathbb C^n$ be deterministic with $\|x_n\|_2=1$. Assume $N_n/n\to\kappa\in(0,\infty)$. For fixed $z=u+i\eta$ with $\eta>0$, set
$$A_n:=\frac1{N_n}T_n^{1/2}X_nX_n^*T_n^{1/2},\qquad R_n(z):=(A_n-zI)^{-1}.$$
Then $x_n^*R_n(z)x_n-\mathbb E[x_n^*R_n(z)x_n]\to0$ almost surely. Moreover, for every $t>0$ there is a constant $C=C(K,M,z,\kappa)$ such that, for all sufficiently large $n$,
$$\mathbb P\!\left\{|x_n^*R_n(z)x_n-\mathbb E[x_n^*R_n(z)x_n]|>t\right\}\le\frac{C}{t^4N_n^2}.$$

items.title: Concentration of the normalized complex Hermitian resolvent trace
items.statement:
On a common probability space, for each positive integer $n$, let $Y_{n,1},\ldots,Y_{n,N_n}$ be independent random vectors in $\mathbb C^n$, let $B_n=\sum_{j=1}^{N_n}Y_{n,j}Y_{n,j}^*$, and assume $N_n/n\to\kappa\in(0,\infty)$. Fix $z=u+i\eta$ with $u\in\mathbb R$ and $\eta>0$, and define
$$M_n(z):=\frac1n\operatorname{tr}(B_n-zI)^{-1}.$$
Then for every $t>0$,
$$\mathbb P\{|M_n(z)-\mathbb E M_n(z)|>t\}\le4\exp\!\left(-\frac{t^2n^2\eta^2}{4N_n}\right),$$
and $M_n(z)-\mathbb E M_n(z)\to0$ almost surely.

items.title: A Hermitian directional spectral measure is a probability law
Deterministic equivalent for the bounded complex sample-covariance resolvent
General-population sample-covariance law for bounded entries
items.statement:
Assume the Axiom of Choice. On a common probability space, for each positive integer $n$, let $N_n$ be a positive integer with $N_n/n\to\kappa\in(0,\infty)$, let $X_n\in\mathbb C^{n\times N_n}$ have entries from one common iid law with mean zero, second absolute moment one and absolute value bounded by one fixed finite constant, and let $T_n$ be deterministic Hermitian positive semidefinite (self-adjoint with $v^*T_nv\ge0$ for every $v$) with uniformly bounded induced Euclidean operator norm. Suppose the empirical eigenvalue measures $H_n=n^{-1}\sum_{i=1}^n\delta_{\lambda_i(T_n)}$ converge weakly to a Borel probability measure $H$ on $[0,\infty)$. Put $c=\kappa^{-1}$ and $A_n=N_n^{-1}T_n^{1/2}X_nX_n^*T_n^{1/2}$, and let $F_n=n^{-1}\sum_{i=1}^n\delta_{\lambda_i(A_n)}$. Then there is a unique Borel probability measure $F_{c,H}$ on $[0,\infty)$ such that, almost surely, $F_n$ converges weakly to $F_{c,H}$. Its Stieltjes transform $m_{c,H}(z)=\int(t-z)^{-1}\,dF_{c,H}(t)$ is the unique $m\in\mathbb C$ satisfying $\operatorname{Im}m>0$, $u:=-(1-c)/z+cm$ with $\operatorname{Im}u>0$, and
$$m=\int_{[0,\infty)}\frac{1}{t(1-c-czm)-z}\,dH(t)\qquad(\operatorname{Im}z>0).$$

items.title: Directional deterministic equivalent for bounded sample-covariance entries
items.statement:
Assume the Axiom of Choice. On a common probability space, for each positive integer $n$, let $N_n$ be a positive integer with $N_n/n\to\kappa\in(0,\infty)$, let $X_n\in\mathbb C^{n\times N_n}$ have entries from one common iid law with mean zero, second absolute moment one and absolute value bounded by a fixed finite constant, and let $T_n$ be deterministic Hermitian positive semidefinite (self-adjoint with $v^*T_nv\ge0$ for every $v$) with uniformly bounded induced Euclidean operator norm and empirical eigenvalue measures $H_n=n^{-1}\sum_i\delta_{\lambda_i(T_n)}\Rightarrow H$. Let $x_n\in\mathbb C^n$ be deterministic unit vectors such that for every $w\in\mathbb C\setminus[0,\infty)$,
$$x_n^*(T_n-wI_n)^{-1}x_n\longrightarrow m_H(w):=\int_{[0,\infty)}(t-w)^{-1}\,dH(t).$$
For $A_n=N_n^{-1}T_n^{1/2}X_nX_n^*T_n^{1/2}$, define the directional spectral measure $\mu_n^{x_n}(B)=x_n^*\mathbf1_B(A_n)x_n$ for Borel $B\subseteq[0,\infty)$. Then almost surely $\mu_n^{x_n}\Rightarrow F_{c,H}$, where $c=\kappa^{-1}$ and $F_{c,H}$ is the probability measure characterized by
$$m_{c,H}(z)=\int_{[0,\infty)}\frac{1}{t(1-c-czm_{c,H}(z))-z}\,dH(t),\qquad \operatorname{Im}z>0.$$
